drums.tags: Funk-rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bass line and clean electric guitar. The bass utilizes a percussive slap-and-pop technique, locking with a tight, dry drum kit. The guitar plays rhythmic, muted 16th-note scratches and staccato chords. A secondary guitar part provides melodic fills with a slight overdrive and wah-wah filter. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the bass and the drum groove, which features a crisp snare and active hi-hat patterns.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[slap electric bass enters with syncopated riff]
[clean electric guitar rhythmic scratches]
[dry drum kit enters with steady backbeat and 16th-note hi-hats]

[Main Groove]
[bass continues slap-and-pop pattern]
[staccato guitar chords on the off-beats]
[occasional wah-wah guitar melodic fills]

[Bridge]
[bass moves to a sustained pedal note]
[guitar scratches intensify]
[drum fill with snare rolls]

[Outro]
[instruments gradually drop out]
[final slap bass flourish]
[kick drum hit]

bass.tags: Alternative rock with a heavy, distorted bass-driven sound. The track features a prominent, fuzzy bass guitar playing a syncopated, rhythmic riff that anchors the composition. A standard drum kit provides a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and driving hi-hats. Gritty, overdriven electric guitar layers enter with power chords and melodic accents. The arrangement is instrumental, focusing on the interplay between the thick bass tone and the percussive elements. 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, key of E minor.
